name: Dr. Manoj Bansal
bio: A postgraduate in science with a doctorate in business entrepreneurship, and over two decades across finance, logistics and infrastructure. He oversees the group’s financial structure and overall strategic direction.

name: Mr Rahul Bansal
bio: A Business Administration graduate with an MBA in International Business Management and over a decade across commerce, finance, licensing and liaisoning. He directs the organisation’s commercial strategy and growth.

name: Mr Purushotam Das Bansal
bio: Over two decades in infrastructure development, central to the group’s road and highway work. He leads day-to-day operations and project execution across the organisation.

name: Mr Parvesh Bansal
bio: Civil Engineering from RIT Bangalore, with a PG diploma from NICMAR Pune, and over a decade of planning experience with Wave Group and Shapoorji Pallonji. He leads project development and planning.

name: Mr Yogesh Bansal
bio: A commerce graduate with more than fifteen years in construction and infrastructure. He leads the company’s sales function and customer engagement.
